title: Sign in and open a private file
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Verify credentials on the paired local server, create a revocable session and open the signed-in Home. Use salted slow password hashes, generic invalid-credential feedback and rate limits.

**Verify** · Sign in through the launcher, open a private file, check wrong credentials, weak passwords, offline and incompatible-server states. Confirm secrets stay out of URLs, browser-accessible storage and evidence.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-058, WI-059, WI-060

**Queue** · Follows WI-060 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
